title: Source register of a counter state
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. For a counter state, its source register is register $2$ in states of type $cA$, $cB$, or $lt$; register $1$ in a state of type $iz$; register $0$ in a state of type $iu$; and register $3$ in a state of type $lb$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
